NONE: › appearing or claiming to be one thing when it is really something else
表面上的；假稱的，假託的

example: Their ostensible goal was to clean up government corruption, but their real aim was to unseat the government.
他們假稱要清除政府腐敗，可真正目的卻是要顛覆政府。

NONE: › the quality of being ostentatious
炫耀，賣弄

example: Her luxurious lifestyle and personal ostentation were both hated and envied.
她奢侈的生活方式和自我炫耀令人又恨又妒。

NONE: › too obviously showing your money, possessions, or power, in an attempt to make other people notice and admire you
鋪張的，擺闊的；炫耀的，賣弄的；招搖的

example: They criticized the ostentatious lifestyle of their leaders.
他們批評領導們鋪張的生活方式。

NONE: › a disease that causes pain and stiffness in the joints (= places where two bones are connected)
骨關節炎
› a type of growth or tumour that is found on bones but is not harmful
骨軟骨瘤
› the scientific study of bones
骨學，骨骼學
› a type of serious bone infection
骨髓炎
› a person who is trained to treat injuries to bones and muscles using pressure and movement
按骨醫生，整骨醫生，骨療醫師
› the treatment of injuries to bones and muscles using pressure and movement
按骨術，整骨術；骨療學
› a disease that causes the bones to become weaker and easily broken
骨質疏鬆（症）

example: 許多老年婦女深受骨質疏鬆之苦。

NONE: › an operation in which bones are cut by a doctor
骨切開術，截骨術
› to avoid someone intentionally, or to prevent someone from taking part in the activities of a group
故意避開；排擠，排斥

example: His colleagues ostracized him after he criticized the company in public.
他公開批評公司之後，同事們對他採取了排斥態度。

C: › a very large bird from Africa that cannot fly
› informal someone who says that a problem does not exist, because they do not want to deal with it
逃避現實者，不願正視現實者

example: The ostrich is the fastest animal on two legs.
鴕鳥是跑得最快的兩足動物。
If you're an ostrich about your debts, you're only going to make matters worse.
如果你不願正視自己的債務問題，只會讓事情變得更糟糕。
